accepted_conclusions: The AIM quantity is the unnormalized raw power sum over all positive coprime moduli.
The printed AIM mean has a+b−1 instead of the correct a+b+1.
The inspected arXiv third-central-moment formula omits 1/N on two pages; FPSAC has the correct normalization, and the exact (3,5) witness forces it.
Ekhad–Zeilberger September 2015 proved-theorem update takes precedence over stale interior conjectural wording.
All-order polynomiality and effective finite computation are prior results. Normalized moments have degree at most 2i in each variable; raw sums include the nonpolynomial rational-Catalan factor.

The written raw-sum conversions, type-A reconstruction and coprime interpolation argument are valid deductions from the stated prior results. The modulus-two formula is elementary and has no novelty acceptance.
not_accepted_or_performed: New compact arbitrary-order formula for arbitrary positive coprime a,b
Complete resolution of the full open-ended AIM problem
Literature-wide nonexistence of a compact formula
Independent all-coefficient recertification of Ekhad–Zeilberger orders four through six or order nine
Full inspection of every source PDF
External human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification
scope_fields.review_status: This is an AI-assisted, unrefereed authored mathematical audit and correction edition. Acceptance records an internal AI audit of prior-result status, normalization and written deductions. It is not external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof-assistant certification, or a novelty or priority claim.
scope_fields.distribution_boundary: This is not a computational reproduction package. The complete authored mathematical audit, every written formula and example, the full correction patch and all substantive acceptance qualifications are retained. Executable code, raw partition or moment datasets, copied source PDFs or text, source renderings, raw search responses and private coordination material are not distributed. Historical finite checks cannot be reproduced from this edition alone.

reason: The AIM item asks for higher unnormalized size power sums for arbitrary positive coprime moduli. This PR claims a normalization/prior-status audit, with established finite-order formulas, already-known all-order lattice sums/polynomiality and an elementary modulus-two special case. It explicitly declines a new arbitrary-order answer and supplies no independently declared completed criterion for the open-ended original request. The exact mean sign and third-central-moment normalization corrections do not resolve that request. No extra compactness criterion is imposed as an original hypothesis, and no literature-wide absence of formulas is asserted.
